intent.problem: Inspect and position simulated lab equipment in a running workcell.

safety.reason: Manual controls operate an OpenUSD model with inert fixtures.

product.benefit: See how the workcell responds to manual controls.
product.how_it_works: Isaac Sim renders the OpenUSD workcell and reports its current joint positions and equipment state.
product.input: The bundled workcell and manual operator controls.
product.output: Live overview and deck cameras, observed equipment state and recent actions.
